hero.heading: Services and Experiences
hero.text: Everything arranged, so you can simply enjoy it.

wine.heading: You come to Montalcino for the wine
wine.lede: Montalcino is the home of Brunello, one of the world's great wines, and Casa Rossa sits among some of its finest vineyards. So we have a wine expert on hand.
paragraphs: Stephanie Barnet leads the high-end client relationships for an exclusive wine members' club in London. She can arrange wine tours of the estates, private tastings and other wine experiences around your stay, whether that is your first taste of Brunello or a search for a particular vintage.
Tell us what you enjoy and Stephanie will plan the rest.

services.heading: We know this corner of Tuscany by heart
services.text: We have lived here for over twenty years. Tell us what you would like and we will arrange it.
services.prebook: Everything below can be arranged by us, but must be booked before you arrive. The best guides, chefs and instructors are in demand all summer and book up quickly, so the earlier you let us know, the better your chances.

items.title: Housekeeping
items.text: The house is overseen by Pat and Valeria. It will be immaculate when you arrive, and refreshed midweek with clean sheets and towels. Extra changes are available on request.

items.title: Private transfers
items.text: Luxury cars and vans with local, English-speaking drivers, to and from Casa Rossa or anywhere in Italy. We do recommend a four-wheel drive for the estate's white roads.

items.title: Restaurant reservations
items.text: We have eaten at all of them. Ask for our list and we will book your table.

items.title: Private chef
items.text: For an intimate dinner, or simply a night off from cooking.

items.title: Brunello tastings
items.text: Visits to some of Montalcino's finest estates, with a long gourmet lunch.

items.title: Cooking classes
items.text: Learn fresh pasta or a local speciality, then eat what you have made, with a glass of Brunello.

items.title: Guided walks
items.text: Hundreds of kilometres of trails cross the Val d'Orcia, and many end at a wonderful restaurant where we can book lunch.

items.title: Cycling
items.text: Bikes and e-bikes to hire for your stay, or a guided ride through the vineyards and along the white roads, with a stop for lunch on the way.

items.title: Yoga and personal training
items.text: Private yoga classes or one-to-one training sessions, at the house, by the pool or out among the olive trees.

items.title: Horse riding
items.text: Rides through the vineyards and woodland around Montalcino, with local stables and guides.

items.title: Days out
items.text: Guided tours of Siena and beyond, or a day at a beach club on the coast with a seafood lunch.

items.title: Peace of mind
items.text: We can help with the local pharmacy, a doctor or anything else you need during your stay.

event.heading: Torneo di Apertura delle Cacce
event.lede: Every August, Montalcino steps back into the Middle Ages for the Torneo di Apertura delle Cacce, the tournament that opens the hunting season.
paragraphs: More than 150 people in fourteenth- and fifteenth-century costume parade through the streets to drums, trumpets and the great bell of the old town hall, led by the lords of the fortress, the standard bearer and the town crier.

Then the four quarters of the town, Borghetto, Pianello, Ruga and Travaglio, send their archers onto the field to shoot at targets shaped like wild boar, from 25 metres back to 45. The rivalry is real, and the winning quarter takes home a gold medal and a specially commissioned work of art.
The festival is usually held over the second weekend of August, with the parade and the tournament on the Sunday evening.
event.tickets: Pat and Mark can organise tickets for the quartiere dinner and tournament for you. Just let us know when you book.
